Suno alternatives

Suno: Whole songs, vocals, lyrics and all, from a line of text, plus a studio to edit them. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI music generators from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1UdioHigh-fidelity song generation, with fine control to extend and remix.Free plan
  2. 2Stable AudioStability AI's music and sound-effect generator, made for production work.Free plan
  3. 3AIVAComposes soundtracks and instrumentals you can edit note by note.Free plan
  4. 4MoisesSplits any song into vocals, drums, bass and the rest, for practice or remixes.Free plan
  5. 5SoundrawRoyalty-free background music you shape by mood, length and tempo.Paid
  6. 6MubertEndless generated music for streams, videos and apps.Free plan
  7. 7BoomyMake a song in seconds and release it to streaming platforms.Free plan
  8. 8BeatovenOriginal soundtracks for videos and podcasts, matched to each scene.Free plan
  9. 9MusicFX DJGoogle's live music generator you steer like a DJ, with text prompts.Free
  10. 10LANDRAI mastering, plus distribution and plugins for musicians.Paid
  11. 11Kits AILicensed AI voices and vocal tools for music producers.Free plan
  12. 12LoudlyRoyalty-free AI music for creators, generated to order.Free plan
  13. 13iZotope OzoneA mastering suite whose assistant listens and suggests a starting master.Paid
  14. 14LALAL.AISplits songs into vocals and instruments with very clean results.Free plan

Free to start: Udio, Stable Audio, AIVA.
